paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP via J/psi -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma in mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma). The only explicit numerical g_agamma value given in text is the exclusion of g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 0.25 GeV/c^2 (2.5e8 eV). The full exclusion curve is only available in Fig. 6, not as a table, so detailed data points cannot be extracted reliably. Branching fraction limits range 8.3e-8 to 1.8e-6.
